name: Forgotten Blood
description:
About This Game

Uncover the dark origins of the Stone Plague, the terrible curse that infests the valley and its inhabitants. Carve your path through ancient ruined temples, swamps inhabited by unspeakable horrors, and churches that gave birth to twisted cults, all shrouded in a mysterious aura that barely conceals its "divine" and "angelic" origins.

Forgotten Blood belongs to the dark fantasy narrative genre with "Angelpunk" influences and explores theological and philosophical themes that delve deeply into the relationship between humanity and the divine.

About the Author

Hi! I'm the solo developer behind Forgotten Blood. Over the past few years I've worked as the programmer, game designer, level designer, concept artist, environment artist, UI designer, and technical artist to bring this world to life.

If you enjoy exploring dark, interconnected worlds and uncovering their secrets, I hope Forgotten Blood leaves a lasting impression. Thank you for your support.
short_desc: Drawn by the call of an ancient crystal dagger, you journey into the Forgotten Valley, now ravaged by the Stone Plague. Forgotten Blood is a first-person action RPG inspired by King’s Field and the Souls series. Explore an interconnected world filled with secrets, danger, and hidden paths.
